result.translation: By the fig and the olive[1947]
result.footnotes: [1947] Referring to the places known for their production, i.e., Damascus and Jerusalem, respectively. It could also refer to the fig and olive trees or to the fruits themselves.

result.arabic_text: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٖ
result.translation: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;[1948]
result.footnotes: [1948] i.e., upright, symmetrical, and balanced in form and nature.

result.translation: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,[1949]
result.footnotes: [1949] This can refer to the depths of Hell, to decrepit old age or to immorality.

result.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ
result.translation: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?[1950]
result.footnotes: [1950] More literally, "What makes you lie concerning it?"

result.translation: Is not Allāh the most just of judges?
